_comment: Published Thai audience research, transcribed from source. This is the
reference layer of the market page: population-level figures that our own
YouTube measurement cannot produce, because measured age needs the
Analytics API of every channel involved.
RULES THIS FILE FOLLOWS, because breaking them would silently corrupt the
1. Age bands are recorded EXACTLY as the source defines them. NBTC works
in generations (Gen Z 14-26), NSO in 6-14/15-24/25-39/40-59/60+, and
our own measurement in 13-19/20-24/25-39/40-54/55+. None of the three
is converted into another. band_scheme names which is in use.
2. No value is estimated, interpolated or averaged. A figure the source
hid behind a paywall is omitted, not guessed.
3. url_status records whether the link was verifiable. The NBTC PDF links
arrived percent-encoding-mangled, so they are marked unverified and the
UI must not present them as working citations.
